text:
alejandra_csm: Planning NoraHealth dedicated bring-up Friday 10:00 PDT. Goal: validate autoscale policies + cost envelope before renewal review. Can infra + ops be on standby?

harry_eng: I can do standby. Quick numbers we should plan for?

alejandra_csm: Target steady traffic ~180 concurrent sessions, planned stress bursts to 360 for 5m. Typical seq len 600, long tails up to 1500 during analytics runs. Renewal note: customer flagged that sustained >$X/unit will shrink renewal odds.

harry_eng: Recommend starting fleet: 6 x H100. Autoscale rule proposal: scale up +2 GPUs when avg_seq_latency > 80ms AND gpu_util > 65% for 2m. Scale down -1 when gpu_util <35% for 8m. Also enable dynamic batching cap at 32.

jin_ops: Pre-warm: replay top 50k user prefixes, warm KV caches. I'll queue a prewarm job. srun id: warm-4220.

sre_bot: warm job warm-4220 submitted. Artifact: s3://redwood-warm/nora/warm-4220/*. Logs will stream to #eng-runtime.

levi_support: Enablement: 20m SRE onboarding + 15m customer walkthru after the first run. I'll create the invite and add runbook link.

harry_eng: Fallback plan: 13b-q4_0 as overflow, 6b-q4 for aggressive shedding. Routing: main->13b-fp16, overflow->13b-q4_0, shed->6b-q4 with 503 soft-shed and degrade notice. Rollback: immediate if error rate >1% for 5m.

alejandra_csm: Acceptance for "go" state: (a) p95 gen latency <=130ms for 95% of 30m soak; (b) p99 <=350ms; (c) error rate <=0.75%; (d) cost per 1k tokens within agreed envelope +/-10%.

grant_fin: I'll confirm cost thresholds and update the renewal risk scoring. If cost goes >10% over, we'll move renewal from green->amber.

harry_eng: Load test plan: three phases: 10m ramp to 180cc, 15m steady @180cc, 3x 5m spike to 360cc separated by 10m recovery. Script: ```bash
./stress --concurrency 180 --seq 600 --steady 15m --spike 360 --repeat 3
``` Prompt set: nora-prime-v2.

sre_bot: Load job created id lr-4220. Preflight smoke will run 3m before full run. Results will land: s3://redwood-loads/nora/lr-4220/*.

jin_ops: I'll add a PagerDuty escalation if autoscale doesn't add capacity within 4m: PD service Nora-Scale-Lag. Condition: new_gpus==0 AND avg_gpu_util>75% for >=4m.

alejandra_csm: Who owns the post-run report and action items? We need a concise summary for renewal packet.

levi_support: I'll take the post-run report. Deliverables: 1-page summary, perf graphs, list of regressions (if any), JIRA epic with owners. ETA 24h post-run.

grant_fin: Please include cost delta and an itemized remediation cost estimate for any suggested changes.

harry_eng: We'll also snapshot model outputs across fp16 vs q4_0 for the prompt set and run regression diffs. Tagging output id: diff-4220.

sre_bot: Reminder: warm-4220 will start 30m prior; lr-4220 preflight smoke at T-3m.

alejandra_csm: Checklist before kickoff: GPUs reserved, prewarm queued, LR job lr-4220 scheduled, PD alert in place, fallback models uploaded, invites sent to customer.

levi_support: All invites created and recordings set to "auto-record". I'll push run link to customer channel 15m before.

jin_ops: I'll be watching first two cycles, + on-call contact: infra-oncall -> harry_eng.

alejandra_csm: Thanks team. If anything changes ping here. Closing thread unless updates come in. :rocket:
